title: A Day on Venus Is Longer Than a Year!

beats.say: If you lived on Venus, your birthday would come before tomorrow does. How?
Hi! I'm Gizmo, your robot friend. Let's blast off to Venus!
Venus spins very, very slowly. One spin takes 243 Earth days!
But one trip around the Sun only takes 225 days.
So a day on Venus is longer than its whole year! And Venus spins backward, too.
Would you like a super long day? Keep looking up, and keep learning. See you next time!

title: Jupiter Has a Storm Bigger Than Earth!

beats.say: You've seen rain storms. Jupiter has one storm bigger than the whole Earth! Where is it?
Hi! I'm Gizmo, your robot friend. Let's zoom to Jupiter!
It's called the Great Red Spot. Can you see it?
This storm is so big, the whole Earth could fit inside it!
Jupiter is the biggest planet, and it's made mostly of gas. There's no ground to stand on!
Can you puff up your cheeks, big like Jupiter? Keep looking up, and keep learning. See you next time!

title: Saturn Could Float in a Bathtub!

beats.say: Your rubber duck floats in the bath. Saturn could float too, in a giant bathtub! Why?
Hi! I'm Gizmo, your robot friend. Let's fly to Saturn!
Saturn is huge, but it's very light for its size. It's made mostly of gas.
So in a giant, giant bathtub, Saturn would float!
And its beautiful rings are made of chunks of ice and rock.
Can you draw a big ring in the air, like Saturn's rings? Keep looking up, and keep learning. See you next time!

title: Moon Footprints Can Last Millions of Years!

beats.say: Your footprints in the sand wash away. On the Moon, footprints can stay for millions of years! Why?
Hi! I'm Gizmo, your robot friend. Let's land on the Moon!
The Moon has no wind and no rain.
So nothing comes along to wipe the footprints away!
Astronauts walked on the Moon more than fifty years ago, and their footprints are still there.
Can you stomp slowly, like an astronaut on the Moon? Keep looking up, and keep learning. See you next time!
